summary: The proposed patch addresses the specific issue but introduces potential regressions and lacks comprehensive testing.

issues.description: The patch introduces a conditional check for `MethodType`, which may inadvertently affect other axes classes not covered by this specific case.
There are no additional tests provided to ensure the fix works for other similar cases or to prevent future regressions.
The patch introduces a more complex conditional logic without clear documentation or comments explaining the rationale behind the changes.
